name: Sheet Set QA
description: Read-only pre-issue checks on the sheets in a saved snapshot: duplicate or non-sequential sheet numbers within a prefix, missing title block fields, sheets with no placed views, and sheet numbers or names that break a pattern. Checks the snapshot cannot support are reported as not run. Optional CSV in the workspace.
author: AEC Model Bridge

snapshot_id.description: Saved snapshot to check. It must contain sheet records.

sheet_numbers.description: Only check these sheet numbers (the issue set). A listed number that is not in the snapshot is an error. Leave empty to check every sheet.

required_fields.description: Sheet or title block fields that must be filled. Defaults to Sheet Number, Sheet Name, Drawn By, Checked By, Sheet Issue Date.

number_pattern.description: Regular expression every sheet number must fully match. Default: letters, optional separator, digits, optional suffix (A-101, S201, M-101.1, A-101a). Empty string turns the check off.

name_pattern.description: Regular expression every sheet name must fully match. Default: no leading or trailing spaces and not the Revit default 'Unnamed'. Empty string turns the check off.

series_size.description: Numbers within a prefix are grouped in series of this size (A-101..A-199 is one series at 100); gaps are only reported inside a series. 1 to 100000.

csv_filename.description: Optional .csv file name inside the workspace with one row per sheet per finding.
